_comment: Config of the combined 'All (compare)' scene (src/export_combined.py). Per slug: how to read the model's own viewer. JS expressions are evaluated in the loaded viewer page with M = window.REEF_MODEL. offshore_scene_xz = the direction 'offshore' in the viewer's three.js scene (X, Z), taken from the model's frame note (see 'frame_note'); hand = +1 if the model's canonical (x along the shore, y offshore) turns clockwise on a north-up map (then combined X = x), -1 otherwise (combined X = -x). Every value is re-checked against the exported meshes; a mismatch fails the check and the reef is shown as 'not in comparison'. Round 11: optional 'area_ref_expr' (+ 'area_ref_label') = a model.js footprint number that includes the flank skirt, used instead of the polygon area as the reference of the area check; 'polygon' may return one ring or a list of rings. Round 11: optional 'shore_mode': 'crossing' replaces the 'seabed near 0 m MSL along y = 0' check for a model whose frame origin is not the shoreline (Borth: defence line at about +5 m). Round 11: optional 'sublabels' [{xy: expression -> [x, y] in the model frame, text: expression -> string}] = extra labels inside a model, drawn in the combined view when the camera is within about 500 m.

prattes-reef-el-segundo.frame_note: model.js frame: x alongshore toward 155 deg, y offshore toward 245 deg (x turned 90 deg clockwise); viewer maps (X = x, Y = z, Z = y)
prattes-reef-el-segundo.crest_note: default state B: max of top_z_apex_msl_m and top_z_tips_msl_m (the top is parallel to the bed)

boscombe-surf-reef.frame_note: model.js frame: x alongshore bearing 83.4, y offshore bearing 173.4 (x turned 90 deg clockwise); viewer maps (X = x, Y = z, Z = y); default reef mode 'idealised'
boscombe-surf-reef.crest_note: design crest +0.5 m ACD = -0.9 m MSL (reef.design.crest_msl_m)

bunbury-airwave.frame_note: model.js frame: x alongshore bearing 12.3, y seaward bearing 282.3 (x turned 90 deg anticlockwise); viewer maps (X = x, Y = z, Z = -y)
bunbury-airwave.crest_note: no stored crest level: seabed grid (z in AHD, bilinear at the reef centre) minus MSL-AHD offset 0.1 m, plus height_default_m (2.0 m)

palm-beach-gold-coast.frame_note: model.js frame: x alongshore toward 334.3, y offshore toward 64.3 (x turned 90 deg clockwise); viewer converts to east/north/up: scene (X = E, Y = up, Z = -N)
palm-beach-gold-coast.crest_note: reef.crest_z (-1.5 m MSL, council design level)

mount-maunganui-reef.frame_note: model.js frame: x alongshore bearing 316.15, y offshore bearing 46.15 (x turned 90 deg clockwise, y = x + 90 deg); viewer maps (X = x, Y = z, Z = y); default outline version (survey -2.0 m CD contour), default bed from model.js
mount-maunganui-reef.area_ref_label: footprint area vs model.js footprint at the bed (the default version has a 1:1 skirt from the -2.0 m contour to the bed)
mount-maunganui-reef.crest_note: crest -0.9 m CD (reef.crest_cd.default) minus MSL above CD 1.13 m = -2.03 m MSL; the bed under the reef is read from model.js at build time (seabed.bed_default_cd)

borth-coastal-defence-reef.frame_note: model.js frame: x alongshore toward SOUTH (bearing 179.57), y offshore toward WEST (bearing 269.57) (x turned 90 deg clockwise); viewer maps (X = x, Y = z, Z = y); default outline version (laser survey, LiDAR 2022)
borth-coastal-defence-reef.area_ref_label: footprint area vs model.js area including the toe berm and blanket (the mesh includes them)
borth-coastal-defence-reef.crest_note: LiDAR p90 of the oval crest strip (+1.75 mODN) minus MSL (+0.31 mODN) = +1.44 m MSL; the default version is the laser-survey surface, the mesh maximum is its highest 1 m cell (design crest +1.50 mODN = +1.19 m MSL)
